unlocks._about: How skills open. Numbers are how many skills must be finished; "all" means every skill in that group.

zones.name: The Workshop
zones.pitch: Three hands-on starters. Read real stuff, make real stuff. Finish any two to open the rest.

zones.name: Everyday Texts
zones.pitch: Stories, letters, songs and books. Work out what they’re for — then make your own.

zones.name: Online & Safe
zones.pitch: Websites, apps and socials. Find your way, check what’s true and keep your stuff safe.

zones.name: Issues & Voices
zones.pitch: Who’s trying to convince you, and how? Spot the angle and the tricks.

zones.name: Speak Up
zones.pitch: Say what you think, listen properly and run a good discussion.

zones.name: Out & About
zones.pitch: Timetables, forms and the places that help. Get real-world stuff done.

zones.name: Next Steps
zones.pitch: Jobs, courses and applications. Get your paperwork ready for what’s next.

zones.name: Your Project
zones.pitch: Pick something you care about, plan it, and show it off. Unlock it by speaking up and planning ahead.

skills.title: Read the Label
skills.tagline: Everything you need is on the pack — if you know where to look.
skills.realLife: Find what matters on real food and product labels, compare two products and choose the better one for you.
skills.literacy: Structures and features of informative texts; purpose and audience; skimming and scanning; working out tricky words.

skills.title: Show Me How
skills.tagline: If someone can follow your steps, you’ve nailed it.
skills.realLife: Write clear step-by-step instructions for something you can do, then test them on a real person.
skills.literacy: Structures and features of instructional texts; planning, drafting and editing; sentence structure and punctuation.

skills.title: Lights, Camera, Message
skills.tagline: How a 3-minute cartoon got millions of people to listen.
skills.realLife: Pull apart a real public-safety ad, then storyboard your own 30-second ad for people your age.
skills.literacy: How film texts use purpose, language and structure to influence an audience; creating a text for a specific audience.

skills.title: What’s the Story?
skills.tagline: Songs, shorts and stories all follow a shape.
skills.realLife: Spot how a song, short film or story is put together, and why it hits the way it does.
skills.literacy: Structures and features of short narratives, song and poetry; purpose and audience.

skills.title: Letters That Work
skills.tagline: The right email gets you the right answer.
skills.realLife: Write a letter or email that gets something done: a refund, a question answered, a time changed.
skills.literacy: Structures and features of letters and emails; creating texts for a specific audience; literacy conventions.

skills.title: Find It in the Book
skills.tagline: Contents, index, headings, blurb: shortcuts to the good bit.
skills.realLife: Use the contents, index, headings and blurb of a real manual or book to find what you need in under a minute.
skills.literacy: Using indexes, headings, subheadings, chapter titles and blurbs to locate information; skimming and scanning.

skills.title: Make a Zine
skills.tagline: Fold it, fill it, hand it out.
skills.realLife: Make a small folded magazine about something you know a lot about, for a real reader.
skills.literacy: Planning, drafting and editing a text for an audience; avoiding plagiarism; literacy conventions.

skills.title: Lock It Down
skills.tagline: Your accounts are worth protecting.
skills.realLife: Set up strong passwords and two-step login on a real account, and know what to do if you’re hacked.
skills.literacy: Recognising and using the features of digital security; reading digital instructions.

skills.title: Website Tour
skills.tagline: Menus, search and footers: find anything on any site.
skills.realLife: Find your way around a real workplace or service website fast, and explain how it’s set out.
skills.literacy: The layout and key features of digital platforms; main ideas and key information in digital texts.

skills.title: Can You Trust It?
skills.tagline: Not everything online is what it says.
skills.realLife: Check whether a website, post or video is reliable before you use it or share it.
skills.literacy: Trustworthiness of digital content; how language and tone relate to purpose and audience.

skills.title: Make a How-To Reel
skills.tagline: Teach something in 60 seconds.
skills.realLife: Plan, film and edit a short how-to video for a real audience, with captions people can read.
skills.literacy: Creating digital texts for an audience; planning, researching, drafting and editing; avoiding plagiarism.

skills.title: Fact or Opinion?
skills.tagline: Know the difference and nobody can spin you.
skills.realLife: Sort the facts from the opinions in a real post or news story about something local.
skills.literacy: Main ideas and arguments in persuasive content; the difference between fact and opinion.

skills.title: Ad Tricks
skills.tagline: Every word and picture in an ad has a job.
skills.realLife: Pull apart real ads to show how words, pictures and sounds are used to get you to buy or act.
skills.literacy: How language and visuals are used to influence an audience; language and tone.

skills.title: Whose Side Are They On?
skills.tagline: Who’s talking changes what they say.
skills.realLife: Compare what two people or groups say about the same issue, and work out why they see it differently.
skills.literacy: How bias and perspective influence a speaker, author and audience; recognising bias.

skills.title: Issue Panel
skills.tagline: Run a Q&A on something your community cares about.
skills.realLife: Research a local issue and run a short Q&A panel where each side gets a fair go.
skills.literacy: Main ideas and arguments; bias and perspective; discussion using evidence; literacy conventions.

skills.title: Body Talk
skills.tagline: What your body says before you open your mouth.
skills.realLife: Practise eye contact, gestures, pace and tone, and see the difference on video.
skills.literacy: Using body language, eye contact, gestures, pace and intonation when presenting opinions.

skills.title: Listen Up
skills.tagline: Good listeners ask the best questions.
skills.realLife: Use active listening and good questions to keep a conversation going and show you understand.
skills.literacy: Active listening and questioning techniques; participating in small-group discussion.

skills.title: Make Your Case
skills.tagline: Point, proof, punch.
skills.realLife: Plan and give a short speech that convinces a real audience to do something, backed by evidence.
skills.literacy: Influencing an audience with language devices; sequencing and structuring a persuasive text with evidence.

skills.title: Run the Room
skills.tagline: Lead a discussion everyone gets a say in.
skills.realLife: Lead a real group discussion or debate: open it, keep it fair, respond to others and wrap it up.
skills.literacy: Leading a discussion with active listening and questioning; body language; structuring a point of view with evidence.

skills.title: Get There
skills.tagline: Timetables and maps, sorted.
skills.realLife: Plan a real trip on public transport using timetables and a journey planner, and write the steps down.
skills.literacy: Skimming and scanning informational documents; summarising instructions into sequential points.

skills.title: Fill the Form
skills.tagline: Get it right the first time.
skills.realLife: Fill in a real form correctly: read the instructions, gather what you need and check before you submit.
skills.literacy: Sourcing and completing documentation; summarising instructions into steps; literacy conventions.

skills.title: Who Can Help?
skills.tagline: The right place to ask saves hours.
skills.realLife: Find the right government or community service for a real problem, and work out how to contact them.
skills.literacy: Identifying reliable government and non-government agencies; reading informative texts for key information.

skills.title: Sort It Out
skills.tagline: Big life admin, one step at a time.
skills.realLife: Take a real piece of life admin — like getting your Learner permit — from start to finish, step by step.
skills.literacy: Reliable agencies; skimming and scanning for relevance; summarising and paraphrasing instructions; completing documentation.

skills.title: Job Hunt
skills.tagline: Read a job ad like an employer wrote it — because they did.
skills.realLife: Find real job ads you could apply for and work out exactly what each one is asking for.
skills.literacy: Documents required for work opportunities; reading informative texts about employment.

skills.title: My Resume
skills.tagline: One page that opens doors.
skills.realLife: Build a real one-page resume you’d be happy to hand to an employer.
skills.literacy: Requirements of workplace documentation; planning, drafting and creating a resume; literacy conventions.

skills.title: Check the Course
skills.tagline: Know what you’re signing up for.
skills.realLife: Research a real TAFE course or apprenticeship and check the information is accurate and up to date.
skills.literacy: Locating sources through research; reviewing the accuracy and validity of information.

skills.title: Apply for Real
skills.tagline: Application in, interview ready.
skills.realLife: Complete a real application and practise a mock interview with feedback.
skills.literacy: Requirements of workplace and further-learning documents; completing documents; discussion and problem solving.

skills.title: Pitch Your Project
skills.tagline: Pick it. Plan it. Pitch it.
skills.realLife: Choose a project you care about, agree on it with your teacher, plan it and improve the plan with feedback.
skills.literacy: Negotiating a topic; planning a presentation; refining a plan after feedback; researching and annotating sources.

skills.title: Showcase Day
skills.tagline: Show what you made and what you learnt.
skills.realLife: Give an informative presentation about your project, with slides, video or visuals, and reflect on what you learnt.
skills.literacy: Informative oral presentation with digital support; sequencing information; body language; avoiding plagiarism; literacy conventions.
